subject: Onboarding: Network governance & kickoff for Greenline private deployment
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Greenline IT <it-admin@greenline.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding: Network governance & kickoff for Greenline private deployment

Hi Samir / Greenline IT team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your private VPC deployment. Before we schedule the technical kick-off, we want to confirm a small set of governance and environment checklist items so the kickoff is fully productive. Can you review and reply with any gaps or call out owners next to each item?

1) Network topology and peering
   - Request: final network diagram with subnets, NATs, and peering endpoints (attached: greenline_network_diagram_v1.pdf).
   - Action owner: Greenline network team

2) Edge/site inventory
   - Request: list of on-prem edge locations + public egress IPs, expected concurrent connections per site. If you can add VLAN IDs that would help.

3) KMS & key custody
   - Do you require HSM-backed keys or will Cloud KMS suffice? Please list the KMS service and IAM role that will allow our deployment to fetch keys during provisioning.

4) Service account / role model
   - Provide service account emails or names to be mapped to Redwood runtime and control-plane connectors (least privilege preferred).

5) Egress, audit, and retention policy
   - Confirm egress restrictions and any required log retention (SOC/PCI/other).

6) JIT access window for initial provisioning
   - Request a 2-hour maintenance window where Greenline can open required firewall rules and grant temporary SSH/API access so we can validate probes and KV sync.

7) Regulatory constraints
   - Any required in-region-only routing, restricted data domains, or customer-side inspection appliances we should be aware of?

We propose scheduling a 90-minute technical kickoff once the above items are confirmed. Proposed slots (PST): Wed 12/9 10:00–11:30, Thu 12/10 09:00–10:30. If neither works, suggest one alternative.

Attachments: greenline_network_diagram_v1.pdf (diagram stub)

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Sr. Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192
From: Samir Raza <samir.raza@greenline.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Greenline IT <it-admin@greenline.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 14:34:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Network governance & kickoff for Greenline private deployment

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the checklist — much appreciated. Ive attached our current edge inventory (edge_site_inventory.csv) which includes VLANs and egress IPs for the 4 co-lo sites; well add expected concurrent connections later today.

Quick answers to the KMS questions: we plan to use our on-prem Thales HSM for key custody. We can export a wrapped key to Redwood under an MOU, or if Redwood supports HSM remote attestation we can provide limited readonly credentials to a HSM gateway. Ive copied our security lead (it-admin@greenline.com) on the thread to discuss the exact flow.

For the JIT window, Thu 12/10 09:00–11:00 PST works well for us.

Let me know which of your engineers will join the session and if you need any pre-reads.

Best,
Samir Raza
Director, Infrastructure
Greenline Health
Attachments: edge_site_inventory.csv (csv stub)

- Service accounts: please share the service account emails or shortnames by EOD Wed 12/9 so we can pre-provision IAM bindings.

- JIT window confirmed for Thu 12/10 09:00–11:00 PST. Ill put a provisional invite on the calendar and include an access checklist well run through during the session.
